e21ff54e4264749354e4afbabbeb0eaef8887c83.sourceText: 实物静止时，三个轴合起来的大小应接近1 g。雷达倾斜安装后，重力会分到多个轴上，不要求某一个轴必须等于1，也不要求另外两个轴都为0。这里的 `acc_norm` 与 `gravity` 长度约9.81并不冲突：一个对应原始读数单位，一个对应内部米制计算。
e21ff54e4264749354e4afbabbeb0eaef8887c83.translatedText: When the physical object is stationary, the combined magnitude of the three axes should be close to 1 g\. After the radar is installed at an angle, gravity will be distributed across multiple axes; it is not required that any one axis must equal 1, nor that the other two axes must both be 0\. Here, `acc_norm` and `gravity` having a length of approximately 9\.81 do not conflict: one corresponds to the raw reading unit, and the other corresponds to the internal metric calculation\.

e2d6e43ae75c565e19ae02724c937358d54b826c.sourceText:
| 操作 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| `v = value;` | 赋值（自动切换类型） |
| `v.emplace<T>(args...)` | 原地构造 |
| `std::get<T>(v)` | 获取值（类型不对抛 `std::bad_variant_access`） |
| `std::get_if<T>(&v)` | 安全获取（类型不对返回 nullptr） |
| `v.index()` | 返回当前类型的索引（0-based） |
| `std::visit(visitor, v)` | 用 visitor 模式处理 |
| `std::holds_alternative<T>(v)` | 判断是否持有 T 类型 |
e2d6e43ae75c565e19ae02724c937358d54b826c.translatedText:
| Operation | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `v = value;` | Assignment (automatic type switching) |
| `v.emplace<T>(args...)` | In\-place construction |
| `std::get<T>(v)` | Get value (throws if the type is incorrect: `std::bad_variant_access`) |
| `std::get_if<T>(&v)` | Safe get (returns nullptr if the type is incorrect) |
| `v.index()` | Return the index of the current type (0\-based) |
| `std::visit(visitor, v)` | Process using the visitor pattern |
| `std::holds_alternative<T>(v)` | Determine whether it holds type T |
